characters.name: Elena Aurelia
characters.summary: Eighteen-year-old Elena was raised as the youngest Valmont daughter before being identified as unrelated to the family. Practical, observant and independent, she wants an education and a future she builds herself rather than an identity defined by wealth.
characters.appearance: Her detailed physical appearance has not yet been fixed.
characters.personality: Cheerful, practical, observant and independent. Emotionally sensitive but reluctant to confront people unnecessarily; stubborn at times, occasionally sarcastic and uncomfortable with excessive attention.
characters.history: Raised in the Valmont household for eighteen years. After the real Valmont heiress returns, Elena is gradually marginalised and eventually leaves for a modest apartment. She does not yet know that she was separated from the Aurelius family as a newborn.

abilities.name: Excellent memory
abilities.description: Retains details and information unusually well.

abilities.name: Practical intelligence
abilities.description: Approaches everyday problems with clear, workable solutions.

abilities.name: Financial awareness
abilities.description: Understands the value of money despite growing up wealthy.

abilities.name: Adaptability
abilities.description: Can adjust to unfamiliar circumstances without relying on status.

affiliations.name: Aurelius family
affiliations.description: Biological family; reunion and trust must develop over time.

affiliations.name: Valmont family
affiliations.description: The household that raised her and later sent her away.

relationships.description: A father she has never known.
A mother who has never stopped searching for her.
Playful and generous; often creates comic situations.
Quiet and protective, sometimes excessively suspicious.
Energetic and eager to finally have a younger sister.
Their complicated shared history is shaped by displacement, insecurity and family decisions.

characters.name: Isabelle Valmont
characters.summary: The biological daughter of the Valmont family, returned to the household after eighteen years apart. Intelligent and ambitious, she has dreamed of reclaiming her place but must face the complicated reality of a family that already raised another daughter.
characters.appearance: Her detailed physical appearance has not yet been fixed.
characters.personality: Intelligent, ambitious, socially aware and accustomed to fighting for opportunities. Initially insecure about her place in a family with eighteen years of memories involving Elena.
characters.history: Spent eighteen years away from the Valmont household before being identified as its biological daughter. Her life and ambitions extend beyond her status as an heiress.

affiliations.name: Valmont family
affiliations.description: Biological family and the household she returns to.

relationships.description: Their relationship develops through jealousy, misunderstandings, guilt, competition and the possibility of mutual understanding.

characters.name: Alexander Aurelius
characters.summary: A disciplined and formidable international businessman. He has never abandoned the search for his missing youngest daughter; finding her forces him to learn how to become a father to an eighteen-year-old he has never raised.
characters.appearance: His detailed physical appearance has not yet been fixed.
characters.personality: Disciplined, intelligent, authoritative and reserved. Accustomed to difficult decisions, but emotionally unprepared for the years lost with his daughter.
characters.history: The disappearance of his newborn daughter has remained the one matter he has never been able to resolve. He continued the investigation for eighteen years.

affiliations.name: Aurelius Global
affiliations.description: International holding company chaired by Alexander.

characters.name: Victoria Aurelius
characters.role: Mother · Chairwoman of the Aurelius Foundation
characters.summary: Gentle, intelligent and protective, Victoria has never forgotten her missing daughter. She has preserved Elena's childhood bedroom and the few belongings connected to her birth, while understanding that affection cannot be demanded.
characters.appearance: Her detailed physical appearance has not yet been fixed.
characters.personality: Gentle, intelligent, sophisticated and protective. Deeply emotional about her missing daughter, but mindful that Elena needs time and agency.
characters.history: Spent eighteen years waiting for news of her missing daughter and preserving a place for her in the family home.

affiliations.name: Aurelius Foundation
affiliations.description: The family's education, healthcare and philanthropy organisation.

characters.name: Adrian Aurelius
characters.role: Eldest brother · CEO of Aurelius International Holdings
characters.summary: The family's disciplined eldest son. He initially treats Elena's return like a responsibility to manage, then learns that his sister needs a brother rather than another executive directing her life.
characters.appearance: His detailed physical appearance has not yet been fixed.
characters.personality: Rational, strict, responsible and protective. Highly organised and accustomed to taking charge.
characters.history: Grew up knowing that his youngest sister had disappeared and that the family was still searching for her.

affiliations.name: Aurelius International Holdings
affiliations.description: The principal holding group led by Adrian.

characters.name: Lucien Aurelius
characters.role: Second brother · President of Aurelius Ventures
characters.summary: The family's social butterfly. Lucien loves teasing his siblings and quickly becomes a source of ridiculous situations, especially when his generous gift-giving ignores what Elena actually wants.
characters.appearance: His detailed physical appearance has not yet been fixed.
characters.personality: Playful, sociable, clever and generous. Enjoys teasing his siblings and making grand gestures.
characters.history: Grew up in the Aurelius family while wondering what his missing younger sister might be like.

characters.name: Damien Aurelius
characters.role: Third brother · Director of Aurelius Security and Risk Management
characters.summary: Quiet and observant, Damien oversees security operations. He is initially suspicious of everyone around Elena, and his protective instincts often become excessive.
characters.appearance: His detailed physical appearance has not yet been fixed.
characters.personality: Quiet, observant, straightforward and protective. Tends to assess risks before trusting unfamiliar people.
characters.history: Grew up knowing that the family had a missing youngest daughter. His professional security experience shapes how he approaches her return.

affiliations.name: Aurelius Security and Risk Management
affiliations.description: The family's security and risk operations.

characters.name: Youngest Aurelius Brother (Name TBD)
characters.summary: An energetic and mischievous sixteen-year-old who has spent his childhood wishing for a younger sister. When Elena returns, he appoints himself the family's expert on making her happy.
characters.appearance: His detailed physical appearance has not yet been fixed.
characters.personality: Energetic, mischievous, affectionate and competitive. Eager to spend time with Elena and quick to turn sibling interactions into games.
characters.history: The youngest Aurelius son, who grew up hearing about the sister who disappeared before he could know her.

characters.name: Richard Valmont
characters.role: Father · Head of the Valmont family
characters.summary: An authoritative, pragmatic and reputation-conscious businessman. His decisions about Elena will have consequences that cannot be erased by wealth or belated explanations.
characters.appearance: His detailed physical appearance has not yet been fixed.
characters.personality: Authoritative, pragmatic and highly conscious of family reputation.
characters.history: Head of a powerful national business family. Raised Elena as his daughter before the DNA revelation and the return of Isabelle.

affiliations.name: Valmont Group
affiliations.description: A substantial business group with interests in manufacturing, real estate, retail and domestic finance.

characters.name: Catherine Valmont
characters.summary: A sophisticated and emotionally conflicted mother whose protectiveness toward Isabelle influences the changing atmosphere of the Valmont household.
characters.appearance: Her detailed physical appearance has not yet been fixed.
characters.personality: Sophisticated, emotionally conflicted and protective of Isabelle.
characters.history: Raised Elena for eighteen years before the biological relationship was questioned. Must confront the emotional consequences of how the family treated the daughter she raised.

affiliations.name: Valmont family
affiliations.description: The household and family she manages.

characters.name: Sebastian Valmont
characters.summary: An ambitious and disciplined eldest brother who becomes increasingly distant from Elena after Isabelle returns.
characters.appearance: His detailed physical appearance has not yet been fixed.
characters.personality: Ambitious, disciplined and increasingly distant when family priorities shift.
characters.history: Grew up with Elena as his younger sister. His choices after Isabelle's return will reveal what he values and what he is willing to acknowledge.

affiliations.name: Valmont family
affiliations.description: Eldest son and member of the family business household.

relationships.type: Younger sister he grew up with

characters.name: Nicholas Valmont
characters.summary: Sociable and proud, Nicholas is easily influenced by the shifting family atmosphere and must eventually reckon with his treatment of Elena.
characters.appearance: His detailed physical appearance has not yet been fixed.
characters.personality: Sociable, proud and susceptible to the opinions of people around him.
characters.history: Grew up alongside Elena and initially takes the family's changed priorities as a cue for how he should behave.

affiliations.name: Valmont family
affiliations.description: Second son of the Valmont household.

relationships.type: Younger sister he grew up with

characters.name: Edward Valmont
characters.summary: An intelligent and observant brother whose internal conflict makes him less predictable than the others.
characters.appearance: His detailed physical appearance has not yet been fixed.
characters.personality: Intelligent, observant and conflicted.
characters.history: Shares eighteen years of family memories with Elena. His response to the upheaval and the evidence surrounding the hospital incident will be explored over time.

affiliations.name: Valmont family
affiliations.description: Third son of the Valmont household.

relationships.type: Younger sister he grew up with

characters.name: Lady Seraphina Veyr
characters.summary: Seventeen-year-old daughter of the Duke and Duchess of Veyr. After awakening with memories of a previous life, she recognises herself as the infamous villainess of a fantasy novel and knows that the original story ends with her execution. Practical, observant, blunt and notoriously lazy, she wants a peaceful life but cannot ignore obvious inefficiency. Skilled in accounting, administration, negotiation and pattern recognition; prone to procrastination, impatience and underestimating her growing influence.

characters.name: Duke Alaric Veyr
characters.summary: A formidable, disciplined nobleman responsible for one of Elarion’s most influential duchies. Protective of his daughter and accustomed to governing through established procedures, he is increasingly baffled by her sudden interest in accounts, contracts and local administration.

characters.name: Duchess Evelyne Veyr
characters.summary: An intelligent, socially sophisticated noblewoman experienced in aristocratic politics, family diplomacy and estate management. She understands the dangers of reputation and political appearances better than her daughter, and often recognises the consequences Seraphina has not considered.

characters.name: Crown Prince Theodore Aurelian
characters.summary: A serious, cautious and politically ambitious heir. He initially suspects Seraphina’s reforms are calculated attempts to undermine the monarchy. As he examines the results rather than the rumours, he becomes a professional ally and political counterpart.

characters.name: Liora Everwyn
characters.summary: An eighteen-year-old saintess who works tirelessly among communities throughout the kingdom. Compassionate, intelligent and independent, she understands that goodwill alone cannot repair broken institutions and becomes an important partner in practical reform.

characters.name: Lucien Arkwright
characters.summary: A gifted magical researcher whose organisational and administrative skills are almost nonexistent. His investigation into deteriorating magical infrastructure brings him into Seraphina’s orbit, where her questions expose problems he has long struggled to explain.

characters.name: Mira Bell
characters.summary: A loyal, sensible and observant young woman who frequently manages the everyday consequences of Seraphina’s decisions. Her practical perspective keeps the household grounded and gives the story a view beyond aristocratic assumptions.

characters.name: Cedric Veyr
characters.summary: A responsible administrator involved in the ducal estate’s management. Practical and hardworking, he is initially uncomfortable with Seraphina challenging established procedures, but cannot dismiss the results of her work.

characters.name: Roland Ashford
characters.summary: A meticulous and cautious accountant who knows the estate’s ledgers better than anyone. He values accurate records, dislikes unexplained changes and becomes an essential examiner of the duchy’s financial irregularities.

characters.name: General Cassian
characters.summary: A disciplined, direct commander responsible for military readiness and border logistics. He approaches reforms through measurable outcomes and is wary of plans that ignore supply lines, manpower or the realities faced by soldiers.

characters.name: Minister Garrick
characters.summary: A defensive and politically experienced minister who has spent years navigating the royal treasury’s competing interests. He sees Seraphina’s questions as a threat to established arrangements and knows how much a proper audit could uncover.

characters.name: Baroness Amelia Rosenthal
characters.summary: A sharp, influential noblewoman with a deep understanding of court alliances and social reputation. She is difficult to impress and rarely accepts a public explanation without considering who benefits from it.

characters.name: Professor Edmund Vale
characters.summary: An intellectual and stubborn scholar familiar with the Academy’s research culture and institutional weaknesses. He values evidence but is slow to accept criticism of traditions he helped preserve.

characters.name: King Edmund III
characters.summary: A pragmatic ruler constrained by court factions, inherited agreements and the practical limits of royal authority. He recognises that the kingdom needs reform but must decide how much disruption the crown can survive.

characters.name: Xu Yuru
characters.role: Main protagonist · Empress of Great Yong
characters.summary: Thirty-eight-year-old Xu Yuru is the composed, practical and politically perceptive empress. Years of experience have made her the person everyone relies on to keep the imperial household functioning. Her dry humour and growing refusal to accept every responsibility conceal neither incompetence nor cruelty: she simply wants duties returned to the offices that should perform them.
characters.personality: Intelligent, composed, practical, observant and firm. Kind without being endlessly accommodating; dislikes needless confrontation and struggles to delegate.
characters.history: Born into the Xu aristocratic clan and educated in literature, classical texts, etiquette, household management, financial administration and political history. She became crown princess and later empress. Her resignation follows years of administrative imbalance.

characters.name: Shen Mingzhao
characters.role: Second protagonist · Eldest daughter of the Marquis of Qingyuan
characters.summary: Twenty-six-year-old Shen Mingzhao is proud, calculating, observant and exceptionally particular about money. For years she has managed her family's estate and accounts while being expected to sacrifice her own interests. When her family tries to favour her younger brother while keeping her responsible for its affairs, she demands a formal division of the fortune and leaves to establish an independent household.
characters.personality: Proud, demanding, intelligent, suspicious and occasionally vindictive. Negotiates aggressively, remembers insults and can be controlling; her decisions are not automatically correct.
characters.history: Raised in the Qingyuan Marquisate and educated in classical literature, household administration, accounting, estate management, etiquette, correspondence and commercial affairs. Her departure exposes financial and administrative problems previously hidden by her work.

characters.name: Zhao Jingheng
characters.summary: Forty-three-year-old Zhao Jingheng is an intelligent, experienced ruler who has become accustomed to relying on the empress for the inner imperial household's administration. He is not foolish; his blind spot is believing that asking Yuru to handle a problem is an efficient solution.
characters.personality: Intelligent, politically experienced, accustomed to delegation and slow to recognise how much responsibility has accumulated on the empress.
characters.history: Rules Great Yong and enjoys the stability created by Yuru's administration. Her resignation forces him to distinguish imperial authority from the daily work of the imperial household.

characters.name: Zhao Cheng'an
characters.summary: Twenty-one-year-old Zhao Cheng'an is serious and disciplined. He respects his mother but has little experience with the inner palace's daily administration. His responsibilities gradually teach him that imperial authority depends on functioning institutions, not on one capable person quietly doing everyone's work.
characters.personality: Serious, disciplined, respectful and inexperienced in internal household administration.
characters.history: The designated heir of Great Yong and eldest surviving son of the emperor and empress.

characters.name: Zhao Chengyu
characters.summary: Eighteen-year-old Zhao Chengyu is competitive, confident and ambitious. His awareness of rank and succession creates occasional political complications, but he is not inherently evil or treacherous.
characters.personality: Competitive, confident, ambitious and conscious of political status.
characters.history: The emperor and empress's second son. His relationship with the crown prince develops through the ordinary pressures of imperial family and court life.

characters.name: Zhao Minglan
characters.summary: Sixteen-year-old Zhao Minglan is curious and observant, with a strong interest in education, administration and the practical operation of the imperial household. Her relationship with Yuru includes instruction, disagreements and gradual independence.
characters.personality: Observant, curious, studious and interested in practical administration.
characters.history: The emperor and empress's daughter. She watches the consequences of her mother's resignation and begins learning how institutions work.

characters.name: Empress Dowager Wei
characters.summary: At sixty-four, Empress Dowager Wei is traditional, influential and protective of imperial authority. She believes the empress's position carries obligations beyond personal preference, placing her at odds with Yuru's understanding of duty and institutional responsibility.
characters.personality: Traditional, influential, politically aware and protective of imperial authority.
characters.history: The emperor's mother and senior woman of the imperial family. Her disagreements with Yuru arise from different views of the empress's obligations.

characters.name: Shen Guowei
characters.summary: Fifty-two-year-old Shen Guowei is proud and politically cautious. He wants to preserve the family's standing, dislikes public disputes and initially expects Mingzhao to compromise rather than challenge the household's distribution of responsibilities and property.
characters.personality: Proud, politically cautious, reputation-conscious and reluctant to confront internal unfairness.
characters.history: Head of the Qingyuan Marquisate. He has allowed household privileges and obligations to become unevenly distributed.

characters.name: Madam Liang
characters.role: Legal wife of the Marquis · Mother
characters.summary: Forty-eight-year-old Madam Liang is status-conscious and emotionally complicated. She expects Mingzhao to understand her family responsibilities without questioning them, and her concern for reputation shapes her response to the division of property.
characters.personality: Status-conscious, socially aware, emotionally complicated and concerned with family hierarchy.
characters.history: The legal wife of Shen Guowei and mother of the Shen children. Her relationship with Mingzhao is strained by expectations that the eldest daughter should keep sacrificing.

characters.name: Shen Mingyuan
characters.role: Eldest son of the Qingyuan Marquisate
characters.summary: Twenty-three-year-old Shen Mingyuan is the favoured son. He has enjoyed family privileges without being required to understand the accounts and obligations that support his lifestyle. He is not automatically malicious; his choices and their consequences shape his development.
characters.personality: Favoured, careless with money and accustomed to privilege.
characters.history: The marquis's eldest son and Mingzhao's younger brother. The division of family property forces him to confront responsibilities he previously left to others.

characters.name: Shen Mingxiu
characters.role: Younger daughter of the Qingyuan Marquisate
characters.summary: Nineteen-year-old Shen Mingxiu is charming, ambitious and socially perceptive. She sometimes benefits from her mother's favouritism and struggles to understand why Mingzhao refuses to continue making sacrifices for the family.
characters.personality: Charming, ambitious, socially perceptive and conscious of family standing.
characters.history: The younger daughter of the Marquis of Qingyuan. Her position in the family is affected by the division and the changing relationships among the siblings.

characters.name: Old Madam Shen
characters.summary: Seventy-three-year-old Old Madam Shen prioritises continuity, obedience and the family's public reputation. Her traditional view of family hierarchy informs her opposition to Mingzhao's decision, though she has her own history and reasons for holding it.
characters.personality: Traditional, authoritative and concerned with family hierarchy and reputation.
characters.history: The senior matriarch of the Qingyuan household and grandmother of Mingzhao.

characters.name: Zhou De
characters.role: Senior steward of the Qingyuan Marquisate
characters.summary: Fifty-seven-year-old Zhou De is an experienced and cautious steward who understands the estate's practical affairs better than most members of the family. His knowledge of financial records makes him important to the property division and later investigations.
characters.personality: Experienced, cautious, observant and knowledgeable about estate administration.
characters.history: Long-serving senior steward of the Shen household, familiar with its property, accounts and day-to-day operations.

relationships.type: The daughter whose accounts he knows

characters.name: Fang Ru
characters.summary: A competent, conservative and experienced palace administrator. Fang Ru understands the routines and regulations of the imperial household and is concerned about how its work will be distributed after Yuru resigns.
characters.personality: Competent, conservative, experienced and procedural.
characters.history: A senior administrator within the imperial household.

characters.name: Consort Liu
characters.summary: Politically intelligent and ambitious, Consort Liu understands the influence that palace administration and ceremonial arrangements can carry.
characters.personality: Politically intelligent, ambitious and attentive to court dynamics.
characters.history: An imperial consort whose interests sometimes intersect with changes in inner-palace administration.

characters.name: Consort Han
characters.summary: Quiet, observant and cautious, Consort Han tends to notice tensions and changes before speaking about them.
characters.personality: Quiet, observant and cautious.
characters.history: An imperial consort within the Great Yong inner palace.

characters.name: Gao Shun
characters.summary: An experienced palace official familiar with the routines, personnel and practical machinery of the imperial household.
characters.personality: Experienced, discreet and administratively knowledgeable.
characters.history: Serves as chief eunuch in the imperial palace.

characters.name: Wei Zhong
characters.summary: A senior minister who supports administrative accountability and believes that responsibilities should be handled by the proper offices.
characters.personality: Experienced, principled about administrative accountability and attentive to jurisdiction.
characters.history: Serves in the central court of Great Yong.

characters.name: Minister Lu
characters.summary: A revenue official concerned with expenditure, taxation and the accuracy of public accounts.
characters.personality: Practical, financially minded and concerned with expenditure and taxation.
characters.history: Works within Great Yong's central revenue administration.

characters.name: Qiao Yue
characters.summary: Mingzhao's loyal but outspoken personal attendant. She supports her mistress's independent household while retaining her own opinions.
characters.personality: Loyal, outspoken and practical.
characters.history: Serves Shen Mingzhao before and after her departure from the Qingyuan Marquisate.

characters.name: Lin Shuyun
characters.summary: An independent merchant and potential commercial associate of Mingzhao. Her business interests give her reasons to negotiate carefully rather than simply agree with a noblewoman.
characters.personality: Independent, commercially minded and pragmatic.
characters.history: A merchant active in Yongjing's commercial networks.

characters.name: Steward He
characters.role: Estate manager of Mingzhao's independent household
characters.summary: Responsible for the daily administration of Mingzhao's independent residence and its household operations.
characters.personality: Practical, organised and responsible.
characters.history: Manages the day-to-day affairs of Mingzhao's new household.

characters.name: Accountant Sun
characters.summary: Handles commercial accounts and financial records for Mingzhao's independent affairs.
characters.personality: Careful, methodical and financially literate.
characters.history: Works with Mingzhao's independent household and commercial accounts.

characters.name: Madam Xu
characters.summary: A neighbouring noblewoman who becomes a social acquaintance and occasional rival to Mingzhao.
characters.personality: Socially perceptive and competitive.
characters.history: Moves within the noble society of Yongjing.
